数据展示

表格 AsamTable

展示已经获得的结构化行数据，并管理选择、排序和本地加载呈现。

使用场景 ​

展示已经获得的结构化行数据，并管理选择、排序和本地加载呈现。

契约与组合 ​

行数据由 data 提供，row-key 支持字段路径或函数。原生表格 props、事件与实例方法保留 Row 泛型；ASAM 增加四档 size（控件密度）、loading、默认选中键、跨数据刷新选择保留、工具栏和分页。密度使用 large / big / default / small；行高由内容和行密度决定。使用 selectable 生成选择列，或自行放置 type="selection" 的列，两种方式任选其一。defaultSelectedRowKeys 是默认选择意图；用户清除或取消后的选择不会因无关刷新反复恢复。

getSelectionRows 返回全选行，getHalfSelectionRows 返回 checkStrictly=false 的真实半选父行；getSelection 是 ASAM 当前选择快照。实例参数及返回值保留具体 Row，类型示例同时拒绝错误字段。row-click / row-contextmenu / row-dblclick 的 column 可能为 null，清空排序时 sort-change.prop 可能为 null。

列的 prop 可以使用嵌套字段路径。父 Table 的 Row 不会自动成为所有子列的模板类型；TS 作用域插槽在对应列前添加 <!-- @vue-generic {Row} -->，或用 const RowColumn = AsamTableColumn<Row>。JS 使用普通数据对象。tooltipFormatter 支持字符串和 VNode，Table 的默认格式可以被某一列覆盖。

固定列、固定表头、分组表头、展开详情、树与懒加载、排序、筛选、合并及汇总都使用真实 Table / TableColumn 入口。懒加载 resolve 在 Table 卸载后被忽略，避免迟到数据改变已销毁实例；宿主定时器或请求仍由宿主在卸载时取消。filteredValue 属于父状态，确认面板筛选不会原地修改传入数组。

完整实例公开面 ​

ref 的顶层值采用 Vue 浅解包：直接读取 isEmpty / columns / tableLayout，不再读取 .value。全部45项对齐固定2.14.7的显式 defineExpose；对象视图只读借用，不直接修改，业务动作优先使用具名公开方法。具体类型由 AsamTableExpose<Row> 保留；ASAM 另加 getSelection(): Row[] 当前选择快照。

字段/方法 值与调用契约
ns 原生 namespace 视图，可读取 b / e / m 等类名函数。
layout 原生布局对象的只读借用视图；观察布局结果。
store 原生选择、列与树状态的只读借用视图；不承诺任意私有子命令。
columns 当前表头第一层的 TableColumnCtx<Row>[] 计算视图。
handleHeaderFooterMousewheel (event: WheelEvent, delta: { pixelX: number; pixelY: number })；处理已归一化的表头/表尾滚轮。
handleMouseLeave () => void；清除行悬停状态及原生 hover 记录。
tableId 原生实例的 string 标识。
tableSize 原生有效密度：空字符串 / large / default / small；ASAM 的 big 映射由尺寸作用域负责。
isHidden boolean；原生布局初始化隐藏状态。
isEmpty boolean；当前原生数据是否为空。
renderExpanded 原生显式 expose 的展开渲染器引用：函数或 null。2.14.7 的列实际写入 context.renderExpanded，因此展开正文可正常渲染而该独立引用仍为 null；不要据此判断是否存在展开列。
resizeProxyVisible boolean；表头调整列宽代理是否显示。
resizeState width / height / headerHeight 为 number 或 null 的测量视图。
isGroup boolean；是否存在分组表头。
bodyWidth string；原生表体布局宽度。
tableBodyStyles { width: string }；表体的计算样式。
emptyBlockStyle { width: string; height: string } 或 undefined；空数据块的计算样式。
debouncedUpdateLayout 可调用的延迟布局更新函数，同时保留 cancel() 与 flush()。
setCurrentRow (row?: Row) => void；设置当前行，无参数清除。
getSelectionRows () => Row[]；返回全选行。
getHalfSelectionRows () => Row[]；checkStrictly=false 时返回半选父行。
toggleRowSelection (row: Row, selected?: boolean, ignoreSelectable?: boolean) => void；切换或明确设定行选择。
clearSelection () => void；清除选择并抑制当前 ASAM 默认选择意图。
clearFilter (columnKeys?: string | string[]) => void；按列键或全部清除筛选。
toggleAllSelection () => void；切换全部行选择。
toggleRowExpansion (row: Row, expanded?: boolean) => void；切换详情/树展开。
clearSort () => void；清除排序。
doLayout () => void；重算原生布局。
sort (prop: string, order: string) => void；按公开列字段与原生排序顺序更新。
updateKeyChildren (key: string, children: Row[]) => void；更新已懒加载的子节点，并继续应用未被用户清除的默认子节点意图。
t 原生 Translator；按 locale 键和可选命名参数翻译。
setDragVisible (visible: boolean) => void；设置列宽拖动代理可见性。
context 原生 Table<Row> 上下文的只读借用视图；可观察当前原生上下文，私有子命令不作为稳定的业务 API。
computedSumText string；有效汇总标题。
computedEmptyText string；有效空数据文案。
computedTooltipEffect 有效 tooltip effect 或 undefined。
computedTooltipOptions 有效原生 tooltip options 对象或 undefined。
tableLayout auto / fixed；当前有效表格布局。
scrollbarViewStyle 原生滚动内容样式对象。
scrollbarStyle 随 height / maxHeight 与表头表尾高度计算的滚动视窗样式对象。
scrollBarRef 实际滚动条实例或 undefined（挂载前/卸载后）；支持 Scrollbar 公开方法和 DOM wrapRef。
scrollTo 原生 scrollTo 数字坐标或 ScrollToOptions 签名；滚动表体。
setScrollLeft (left?: number) => void；设置水平滚动位置。
setScrollTop (top?: number) => void；设置垂直滚动位置。
allowDragLastColumn boolean；原生显式 expose 的初始 prop 快照，不承诺响应式跟随后续 prop 改变。

默认选中遍历 treeProps.children（默认 children）的所有后代，支持嵌套字符串与函数 row-key；懒加载 resolve 后继续应用默认意图，公开 updateKeyChildren 更新已记录子节点。用户清除、单行取消、全选清除或关联父行取消后，无关数据刷新不会恢复被取消的默认后代。完整 tree-defaults 示例包含自定义 nodes、静态后代与延迟解析子节点，宿主取消自有计时器。

模板与预览边界 ​

TS 列插槽需要显式 Row 时，使用列前的 @vue-generic 注释；完整 usage-custom-column 与 basic 示例可直接运行。图片可以作为列的 default 内容；预览由 AsamImage 提供，设置其 previewTeleported 为 true 将预览层传送到外部，避免表格固定列或滚动层的裁剪。表格负责承载普通插槽内容，图片及预览能力以该组件文档为准。直接写在 HTML DOM 中的组件必须使用完整闭合标签；SFC 编译支持自闭合，但浏览器 HTML 解析器不会将自定义标签当作 input/img。

基础用法与状态 ​

基础用法与状态

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<label>
		<span>控件密度</span>
		<select v-model="size">
			<option v-for="value in sizes" :key="value">{{ value }}</option>
		</select>
	</label>
	<button type="button" @click="loading = !loading">切换本地加载状态</button>
	<AsamTable
		v-bind="{ data: rows, rowKey: 'id', selectable: true, loading, size }"
		@selection-change="selection = $event"
	>
		<template #toolbar="{ selection: current }">
			<span>已选 {{ current.length }} 项</span>
		</template>
		<!-- @vue-generic {Row} -->
		<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="名称" min-width="150">
			<template #default="{ row }">
				<span>{{ row.name }}</span>
			</template>
		</AsamTableColumn>
		<AsamTableColumn v-bind="{ prop: 'count', label: '数量', sortable: true, width: 100 }" />
		<template #empty>没有本地记录</template>
	</AsamTable>
	<p role="status">选中键：{{ selection.map((row) => row.id).join(', ') }}</p>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	count: number;
}
const rows: Row[] = [
	{ id: 1, name: '本地草稿', count: 3 },
	{ id: 2, name: '本地记录', count: 8 }
];
const selection = ref<Row[]>([]);
const loading = ref(false);
const sizes: AsamControlSize[] = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
</script>
vue

	<label>
		<span>控件密度</span>

			<option v-for="value in sizes" :key="value">{{ value }}</option>
		</select>
	</label>
	<button type="button" @click="loading = !loading">切换本地加载状态</button>
	<AsamTable

	>

			<span>已选 {{ current.length }} 项</span>
		</template>

		<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="名称" min-width="150">
			<template #default="{ row }">

			</template>
		</AsamTableColumn>
		<AsamTableColumn v-bind="{ prop: 'count', label: '数量', sortable: true, width: 100 }" />

	</AsamTable>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const rows = [
	{ id: 1, name: '本地草稿', count: 3 },
	{ id: 2, name: '本地记录', count: 8 }
];

const loading = ref(false);
const sizes = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
const size = ref('default');
</script>

树后代与懒加载默认选择 ​

树后代与懒加载默认选择

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<label><input v-model="customChildren" type="checkbox" />使用 nodes 子节点字段</label>
	<button @click="staticTable?.clearSelection()">清除树默认选择</button>
	<AsamTable
		ref="staticTable"
		:data="rows"
		row-key="id"
		selectable
		default-expand-all
		:default-selected-row-keys="[11]"
		:tree-props="{ children: customChildren ? 'nodes' : 'children', checkStrictly: true }"
		@selection-change="recordStatic"
	>
		<AsamTableColumn prop="label" label="静态树" />
	</AsamTable>
	<p data-testid="tree-default-static">静态选择 {{ staticSelection.join(',') }}</p>
	<AsamTable
		:data="lazyRows"
		row-key="id"
		selectable
		lazy
		:default-selected-row-keys="[21]"
		:tree-props="{ children: 'children', hasChildren: 'hasChildren', checkStrictly: true }"
		:load="load"
		@selection-change="recordLazy"
	>
		<AsamTableColumn prop="label" label="懒加载树（展开后解析默认选择）" />
	</AsamTable>
	<p data-testid="tree-default-lazy">懒加载选择 {{ lazySelection.join(',') }}</p>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableTreeDefaultsDemo' });
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableExpose, AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	children?: Row[];
	nodes?: Row[];
	hasChildren?: boolean;
}
const customChildren = ref(false);
const staticTable = shallowRef<AsamTableExpose<Row>>();
const staticSelection = ref<number[]>([]),
	lazySelection = ref<number[]>([]);
const rows = computed<Row[]>(() => [
	{
		id: 1,
		label: '父节点',
		[customChildren.value ? 'nodes' : 'children']: [
			{ id: 11, label: '默认选中子节点' },
			{ id: 12, label: '其他子节点' }
		]
	}
]);
const lazyRows: Row[] = [{ id: 2, label: '待加载父节点', hasChildren: true }];
const timers = new Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
let disposed = false;
function recordStatic(selection: Row[]): void {
	staticSelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
function recordLazy(selection: Row[]): void {
	lazySelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
const load: AsamTableProps<Row>['load'] = (_row, _node, resolve) => {
	const timer = setTimeout(() => {
		timers.delete(timer);
		if (!disposed) resolve([{ id: 21, label: '解析后默认选中子节点' }]);
	}, 150);
	timers.add(timer);
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	timers.forEach((timer) => clearTimeout(timer));
	timers.clear();
});
</script>
vue
<template>
	<label><input v-model="customChildren" type="checkbox" />使用 nodes 子节点字段</label>
	<button @click="staticTable?.clearSelection()">清除树默认选择</button>
	<AsamTable
		ref="staticTable"
		:data="rows"
		row-key="id"
		selectable
		default-expand-all
		:default-selected-row-keys="[11]"
		:tree-props="{ children: customChildren ? 'nodes' : 'children', checkStrictly: true }"
		@selection-change="recordStatic"
	>
		<AsamTableColumn prop="label" label="静态树" />
	</AsamTable>
	<p data-testid="tree-default-static">静态选择 {{ staticSelection.join(',') }}</p>
	<AsamTable
		:data="lazyRows"
		row-key="id"
		selectable
		lazy
		:default-selected-row-keys="[21]"
		:tree-props="{ children: 'children', hasChildren: 'hasChildren', checkStrictly: true }"
		:load="load"
		@selection-change="recordLazy"
	>
		<AsamTableColumn prop="label" label="懒加载树（展开后解析默认选择）" />
	</AsamTable>
	<p data-testid="tree-default-lazy">懒加载选择 {{ lazySelection.join(',') }}</p>
</template>
<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableTreeDefaultsDemo' });
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const customChildren = ref(false);
const staticTable = shallowRef();
const staticSelection = ref([]),
	lazySelection = ref([]);
const rows = computed(() => [
	{
		id: 1,
		label: '父节点',
		[customChildren.value ? 'nodes' : 'children']: [
			{ id: 11, label: '默认选中子节点' },
			{ id: 12, label: '其他子节点' }
		]
	}
]);
const lazyRows = [{ id: 2, label: '待加载父节点', hasChildren: true }];
const timers = new Set();
let disposed = false;
function recordStatic(selection) {
	staticSelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
function recordLazy(selection) {
	lazySelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
const load = (_row, _node, resolve) => {
	const timer = setTimeout(() => {
		timers.delete(timer);
		if (!disposed) resolve([{ id: 21, label: '解析后默认选中子节点' }]);
	}, 150);
	timers.add(timer);
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	timers.forEach((timer) => clearTimeout(timer));
	timers.clear();
});
</script>

			]"

		/>

			prop="tag"
			label="Tag"
			width="100"
			:filters="[

			]"
			:filter-method="filterTag"
			filter-placement="bottom-end"
		>
			<template #default="scope">

					:type="scope.row.tag === 'Home' ? 'primary' : 'success'"

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageFilterDemo' });
import { AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
	tag: string;
}

const tableRef = ref<AsamTableExpose<User>>();

const resetDateFilter = () => {
	tableRef.value!.clearFilter(['date']);
};
const clearFilter = () => {
	tableRef.value!.clearFilter();
};
const formatter = (row: User) => {
	return row.address;
};
const filterTag = (value: string, row: User) => {
	return row.tag === value;
};
const filterHandler = (value: string, row: User, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<User>) => {
	const property = column['property'];
	return property in row && Reflect.get(row, property) === value;
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: 'Tom',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles',
		tag: 'Home'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: 'Tom',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles',
		tag: 'Office'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-04',
		name: 'Tom',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles',
		tag: 'Home'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: 'Tom',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles',
		tag: 'Office'
	}
];
</script>

	<AsamTable ref="tableRef" row-key="date" :data="tableData" style="width: 100%">
		<AsamTableColumn
			prop="date"
			label="Date"
			sortable
			width="180"
			column-key="date"
			:filters="[
				{ text: '2016-05-01', value: '2016-05-01' },
				{ text: '2016-05-02', value: '2016-05-02' },
				{ text: '2016-05-03', value: '2016-05-03' },
				{ text: '2016-05-04', value: '2016-05-04' }
			]"

					type="primary"
					size="small"

				>

				</AsamButton>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageFixedHeaderWithFluidHeaderDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

const now = new Date();

const tableData = ref([
	{
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: 'Tom',
		state: 'California',
		city: 'Los Angeles',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: 'Tom',
		state: 'California',
		city: 'Los Angeles',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: 'Tom',
		state: 'California',
		city: 'Los Angeles',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	}
]);

const deleteRow = (index: number) => {
	tableData.value.splice(index, 1);
};

const onAddItem = () => {
	now.setDate(now.getDate() + 1);
	tableData.value.push({
		date: now.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
		name: 'Tom',
		state: 'California',
		city: 'Los Angeles',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	});
};
</script>

Multiple select

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamTable
		ref="multipleTableRef"
		:data="tableData"
		row-key="id"
		style="width: 100%"
		@selection-change="handleSelectionChange"
	>
		<AsamTableColumn type="selection" :selectable="selectable" width="55" />
		<!-- @vue-generic {User} -->
		<AsamTableColumn label="Date" width="120">
			<template #default="scope">{{ scope.row.date }}</template>
		</AsamTableColumn>
		<AsamTableColumn property="name" label="Name" width="120" />
		<AsamTableColumn property="address" label="Address" />
	</AsamTable>
	<div style="margin-top: var(--asam-space-lg)">
		<AsamButton @click="toggleSelection([tableData[1], tableData[2]])">
			Toggle selection status of second and third rows
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton @click="toggleSelection([tableData[1], tableData[2]], false)">
			Toggle selection status based on selectable
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton @click="toggleSelection()">Clear selection</AsamButton>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageMultiSelectDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTableExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	id: number;
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
}

const multipleTableRef = ref<AsamTableExpose<User>>();
const multipleSelection = ref<User[]>([]);

const selectable = (row: User) => ![1, 2].includes(row.id);
const toggleSelection = (rows?: User[], ignoreSelectable?: boolean) => {
	if (rows) {
		rows.forEach((row) => {
			multipleTableRef.value!.toggleRowSelection(row, undefined, ignoreSelectable);
		});
	} else {
		multipleTableRef.value!.clearSelection();
	}
};
const handleSelectionChange = (val: User[]) => {
	multipleSelection.value = val;
};

const tableData: User[] = [

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageRowspanAndColspanDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import type { AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	id: string;
	name: string;
	amount1: string;
	amount2: string;
	amount3: number;
}

interface SpanMethodProps {
	row: User;
	column: AsamTableColumnCtx<User>;
	rowIndex: number;
	columnIndex: number;
}

const arraySpanMethod = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }: SpanMethodProps) => {
	if (rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
		if (columnIndex === 0) {
			return [1, 2];
		} else if (columnIndex === 1) {
			return [0, 0];
		}
	}
};

const objectSpanMethod = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }: SpanMethodProps) => {
	if (columnIndex === 0) {
		if (rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
			return {
				rowspan: 2,
				colspan: 1
			};
		} else {
			return {
				rowspan: 0,
				colspan: 0
			};
		}
	}
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		id: '12987122',
		name: 'Tom',
		amount1: '234',
		amount2: '3.2',
		amount3: 10
	},
	{
		id: '12987123',
		name: 'Tom',
		amount1: '165',
		amount2: '4.43',
		amount3: 12
	},
	{

		name: 'Tom',
		amount1: '324',
		amount2: '1.9',
		amount3: 9
	},
	{
		id: '12987125',
		name: 'Tom',
		amount1: '621',
		amount2: '2.2',
		amount3: 17
	},
	{
		id: '12987126',
		name: 'Tom',
		amount1: '539',
		amount2: '4.1',
		amount3: 15
	}
];
</script>

Summary row ​

Summary row

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamTable :data="tableData" border show-summary style="width: 100%">
		<AsamTableColumn prop="id" label="ID" width="180" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="Name" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="amount1" sortable label="Amount 1" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="amount2" sortable label="Amount 2" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="amount3" sortable label="Amount 3" />
	</AsamTable>

	<AsamTable
		:data="tableData"
		border
		height="200"
		:summary-method="getSummaries"
		show-summary
		style="width: 100%; margin-top: var(--asam-space-lg)"
	>
		<AsamTableColumn prop="id" label="ID" width="180" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="Name" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="amount1" label="Cost 1 ($)" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="amount2" label="Cost 2 ($)" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="amount3" label="Cost 3 ($)" />
	</AsamTable>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageSummaryDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h } from 'vue';

import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Product {
	id: string;
	name: string;
	amount1: string;
	amount2: string;
	amount3: number;
}

interface SummaryMethodProps<T extends Product = Product> {
	columns: AsamTableColumnCtx<T>[];
	data: T[];
}

const getSummaries = (param: SummaryMethodProps) => {
	const { columns, data } = param;
	const sums: (string | VNode)[] = [];
	columns.forEach((column, index) => {
		if (index === 0) {
			sums[index] = h('div', { style: { textDecoration: 'underline' } }, ['Total Cost']);
			return;
		}
		const values = data.map((item) => Number(Reflect.get(item, column.property)));
		if (!values.every((value) => Number.isNaN(value))) {
			sums[index] = `$ ${values.reduce((prev, curr) => {
				const value = Number(curr);
				if (!Number.isNaN(value)) {
					return prev + curr;
				} else {
					return prev;
				}
			}, 0)}`;
		} else {
			sums[index] = 'N/A';
		}
	});

	return sums;
};

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageSummaryDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { h } from 'vue';
const getSummaries = (param) => {
	const { columns, data } = param;
	const sums = [];
	columns.forEach((column, index) => {
		if (index === 0) {
			sums[index] = h('div', { style: { textDecoration: 'underline' } }, ['Total Cost']);
			return;
		}
		const values = data.map((item) => Number(Reflect.get(item, column.property)));
		if (!values.every((value) => Number.isNaN(value))) {
			sums[index] = `$ ${values.reduce((prev, curr) => {
				const value = Number(curr);
				if (!Number.isNaN(value)) {
					return prev + curr;
				} else {
					return prev;
				}
			}, 0)}`;
		} else {
			sums[index] = 'N/A';
		}
	});
	return sums;
};
const tableData = [
	{
		id: '12987122',
		name: 'Tom',
		amount1: '234',
		amount2: '3.2',
		amount3: 10

追加内容与汇总行 ​

append 用于最后一条数据之后的操作区域。开启 show-summary 时，追加内容显示在汇总行上方；table-layout="auto" 与 fixed 均遵守这个顺序。固定高度的表格保留汇总行的原生吸底行为，滚动到底部可见追加操作。summary-method 仍可返回字符串或 VNode，自定义空表插槽位于追加内容之前。

追加内容与汇总行

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div>
		<p>追加内容位于汇总行上方；固定高度时滚动到底部查看追加操作。</p>
		<label>
			<span>布局</span>
			<select v-model="layout">
				<option>auto</option>
				<option>fixed</option>
			</select>
		</label>
		<label><input v-model="showSummary" type="checkbox" />汇总</label>
		<label><input v-model="showAppend" type="checkbox" />追加内容</label>
		<label><input v-model="empty" type="checkbox" />空表</label>
		<label><input v-model="customSummary" type="checkbox" />自定义 VNode 汇总</label>
		<label><input v-model="fixedHeight" type="checkbox" />固定高度</label>
		<AsamTable
			:data="visibleRows"
			:table-layout="layout"
			:show-summary="showSummary"
			:summary-method="customSummary ? summaries : undefined"
			:height="fixedHeight ? 260 : undefined"
			row-key="id"
			border
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="商品" min-width="160" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="amount" label="数量" min-width="120" />
			<template v-if="showAppend" #append>
				<div class="append-actions">
					<AsamButton @click="add">追加一行</AsamButton>
					<span>已追加 {{ added }} 行</span>
				</div>
			</template>
			<template #empty>暂无商品，可通过追加操作添加。</template>
		</AsamTable>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableAppendSummaryDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Product {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	amount: number;
}
const layout = ref<'auto' | 'fixed'>('auto');
const showSummary = ref(true),
	showAppend = ref(true),
	empty = ref(false);
const customSummary = ref(false),
	fixedHeight = ref(false),
	added = ref(0);
const rows = ref<Product[]>([
	{ id: 1, name: '商品 A', amount: 2 },
	{ id: 2, name: '商品 B', amount: 3 }
]);
const visibleRows = computed(() => (empty.value ? [] : rows.value));
const summaries: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Product>['summaryMethod']> = ({ data }) => [
	h('strong', '数量合计'),
	String(data.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.amount, 0))
];
function add() {
	const id = rows.value.length + 1;
	rows.value.push({ id, name: `商品 ${id}`, amount: 1 });
	added.value++;
	empty.value = false;
}
</script>

}
</style>

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageTooltipFormatterDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type TableData = {

		url: '/component-AsamTable.html'

];

const tableRowFormatter = (data: AsamTableTooltipData<TableData>) => {
	return `${data.cellValue}: table formatter`;
};

	);
};

Table with status ​

Table with status

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamTable :data="tableData" style="width: 100%" :row-class-name="tableRowClassName">
		<AsamTableColumn prop="date" label="Date" width="180" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="Name" width="180" />
		<AsamTableColumn prop="address" label="Address" />
	</AsamTable>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageWithStatusDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
}

const tableRowClassName = ({ rowIndex }: { row: User; rowIndex: number }) => {
	if (rowIndex === 1) {
		return 'warning-row';
	} else if (rowIndex === 3) {
		return 'success-row';
	}
	return '';
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: 'Tom',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: 'Tom',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-04',
		name: 'Tom',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: 'Tom',
		address: 'No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles'
	}
];
</script>

}
</style>

实例、类型与边界 ​

公开 API 与下列完整 SFC 来自同一组件入口。TS 和 JS 演示分别提供所有本地依赖文件；类型约束只出现在 TS 中。远程请求与业务持久化由宿主承担。

API

Types AsamTableRow

公开类型视图
ts
import type { AsamTableRow } from '@asam-ui/ui';

// AsamTableRow
type PublicContract = AsamTableRow;

Types AsamTableRowKey

组合契约按分支生效；请同时查看公开类型。

公开类型视图
ts
import type { AsamTableRowKey } from '@asam-ui/ui';

// AsamTableRowKey
type PublicContract = AsamTableRowKey;

Types AsamTableRowKeyGetter

ts
(row: Row): AsamTableRowKey
公开类型视图
ts
import type { AsamTableRowKeyGetter, AsamTableRowKey } from '@asam-ui/ui';

// AsamTableRowKeyGetter
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	(row: Row): AsamTableRowKey;
};

import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableProps, AsamTableRowKeyGetter, AsamTableRowKey, AsamPaginationProps, AsamTableOverflowTooltipOptions, AsamTableV2Props, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamControlSize, AsamTableSummaryMethod, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableColumnCls, AsamTableColumnStyle, AsamTableV2HeaderCellSlotProps, AsamTableCellCls, AsamTableCellStyle, AsamTableSort, AsamTableTreeNode, AsamTableOverflowTooltipFormatter } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTableProps
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	"data"?: Row[] | undefined;
	"tableLayout"?: ("auto" | "fixed") | undefined;
	"selectable"?: boolean | undefined;
	"rowKey"?: string | AsamTableRowKeyGetter<Row> | undefined;
	"defaultSelectedRowKeys"?: AsamTableRowKey[] | undefined;
	"reserveSelection"?: boolean | undefined;
	"loading"?: boolean | undefined;
	"minWidth"?: string | undefined;
	"pagination"?: AsamPaginationProps | undefined;
	"allowDragLastColumn"?: boolean | undefined;
	"preserveExpandedContent"?: boolean | undefined;
	"style"?: AsamTableProps<Row>["style"];
	"className"?: string | undefined;
	"width"?: string | number | undefined;
	"height"?: string | number | undefined;
	"maxHeight"?: string | number | undefined;
	"fit"?: boolean | undefined;
	"stripe"?: boolean | undefined;
	"border"?: boolean | undefined;
	"showHeader"?: boolean | undefined;
	"showSummary"?: boolean | undefined;
	"sumText"?: string | undefined;
	"summaryMethod"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["summaryMethod"];
	"rowClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["rowClassName"];
	"rowStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["rowStyle"];
	"cellClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["cellClassName"];
	"cellStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["cellStyle"];
	"headerRowClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerRowClassName"];
	"headerRowStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerRowStyle"];
	"headerCellClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerCellClassName"];
	"headerCellStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerCellStyle"];
	"highlightCurrentRow"?: boolean | undefined;
	"currentRowKey"?: string | number | undefined;
	"emptyText"?: string | undefined;
	"expandRowKeys"?: string[] | undefined;
	"defaultExpandAll"?: boolean | undefined;
	"rowExpandable"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["rowExpandable"];
	"defaultSort"?: AsamTableSort | undefined;
	"tooltipEffect"?: string | undefined;
	"tooltipOptions"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["tooltipOptions"];
	"spanMethod"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["spanMethod"];
	"selectOnIndeterminate"?: boolean | undefined;
	"indent"?: number | undefined;
	"treeProps"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["treeProps"];
	"lazy"?: boolean | undefined;
	"load"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["load"];
	"scrollbarAlwaysOn"?: boolean | undefined;
	"flexible"?: boolean | undefined;
	"showOverflowTooltip"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["showOverflowTooltip"];
	"tooltipFormatter"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["tooltipFormatter"];

	"scrollbarTabindex"?: string | number | undefined;

	"size"?: AsamControlSize | undefined;
};

import type { AsamTableEmits, AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

// AsamTableEmits
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	"select": [selection: Row[], row: Row];
	"select-all": [selection: Row[]];
	"selection-change": [selection: Row[]];
	"cell-mouse-enter": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: MouseEvent];

import type { VNode, Ref, ReactiveEffect, ConcreteComponent, ComputedOptions, MethodOptions, AppContext, RendererNode, RendererElement, ComponentPublicInstance, ComponentOptionsBase, ComponentProvideOptions } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableExpose, AsamTableContext, AsamTableRefs, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableV2Props, AsamTableNativeEmits, AsamTableSort, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamTableFilter, AsamTableOverflowTooltipOptions, AsamScrollbarDirection } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTableExpose
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	readonly "sort": (prop: string, order: string) => void;
	readonly "context": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["context"];
	readonly "tableLayout": "auto" | "fixed";
	readonly "allowDragLastColumn": boolean;
	readonly "ns": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["ns"];
	readonly "layout": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["layout"];
	readonly "store": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["store"];
	readonly "columns": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["columns"];
	readonly "handleMouseLeave": () => void;
	readonly "tableId": string;
	readonly "tableSize": "" | "large" | "default" | "small";
	readonly "isHidden": boolean;
	readonly "isEmpty": boolean;
	readonly "renderExpanded": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["renderExpanded"];
	readonly "resizeProxyVisible": boolean;
	readonly "resizeState": { width: null | number; height: null | number; headerHeight: null | number; };
	readonly "isGroup": boolean;
	readonly "bodyWidth": string;
	readonly "tableBodyStyles": { width: string; };
	readonly "emptyBlockStyle": { width: string; height: string; } | undefined;
	readonly "debouncedUpdateLayout": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["debouncedUpdateLayout"];
	readonly "setCurrentRow": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["setCurrentRow"];
	readonly "getSelectionRows": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["getSelectionRows"];
	readonly "getHalfSelectionRows": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["getHalfSelectionRows"];
	readonly "toggleRowSelection": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["toggleRowSelection"];
	readonly "clearSelection": () => void;
	readonly "clearFilter": (columnKeys?: string[] | string) => void;
	readonly "toggleAllSelection": () => void;
	readonly "toggleRowExpansion": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["toggleRowExpansion"];
	readonly "clearSort": () => void;
	readonly "doLayout": () => void;
	readonly "updateKeyChildren": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["updateKeyChildren"];
	readonly "t": AsamTableExpose<Row>["t"];
	readonly "setDragVisible": (visible: boolean) => void;
	readonly "computedSumText": string;
	readonly "computedEmptyText": string;
	readonly "computedTooltipEffect": string | undefined;
	readonly "computedTooltipOptions": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["computedTooltipOptions"];
	readonly "scrollbarViewStyle": { display: string; verticalAlign: string; };
	readonly "scrollbarStyle": { height: string; maxHeight?: undefined; } | { maxHeight: string; height?: undefined; } | { height?: undefined; maxHeight?: undefined; };
	readonly "scrollTo": (options: ScrollToOptions | number, yCoord?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollLeft": (left?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollTop": (top?: number) => void;
	readonly "scrollBarRef": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["scrollBarRef"];
	readonly "handleHeaderFooterMousewheel": (event: WheelEvent, delta: { pixelX: number; pixelY: number; }) => void;
	"getSelection": () => Row[];
};

ts
import type { VNode, Ref, ReactiveEffect, ConcreteComponent, ComputedOptions, MethodOptions, RendererNode, RendererElement, ComponentPublicInstance, ComponentOptionsBase, ComponentProvideOptions } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableContext, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamTableRefs, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableV2HeaderCellSlotProps, AsamTableNativeEmits, AsamTableSort, AsamTableV2Props } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTableContext
type PublicContract<T extends { [x: string]: any; [x: number]: any; [x: symbol]: any; } = any> = {
	"$ready": boolean;
	"hoverState"?: (AsamTableContext<T>)["hoverState"];
	"renderExpanded": (AsamTableContext<T>)["renderExpanded"];
	"store": (AsamTableContext<T>)["store"];
	"layout": (AsamTableContext<T>)["layout"];
	"refs": AsamTableRefs;
	"tableId": string;
